sloka: यदा तुष्टः तु भरतः रामस्य इह भविष्यति ।सा इयम् स्वस्तिमयी सेना गन्गाम् अद्य तरिष्यति ॥२-८४-९॥
transliteration: yadā tuṣṭaḥ tu bharataḥ rāmasya iha bhaviṣyati ।sā iyam svastimayī senā gangām adya tariṣyati ॥2-84-9॥

translations.english: Should it happen that Bharata is not illdisposed toward Rama, the army will safe cross the river Ganga today itself.
